title: RomanBridge DAO (Series 15) — Pont du Gard
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell built beside the Pont du Gard aqueduct on the Gardon River. Six zones along the Roman bridge and gorge turn governance, research, proposals, operations and progress tracking into a walkable riverside campus under Mediterranean scrub and stone pines.

buildings.name: Aqueduct Charter House
buildings.use: Charter display and human voting hall

buildings.name: Contribution Registry
buildings.use: Records of member contributions and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: L'Estel Synthesis Lab
buildings.use: Evidence monitoring and research synthesis workshop

buildings.name: Evidence Archive
buildings.use: Storage of monitored sources and summaries

buildings.name: Gardon Proposal Forum
buildings.use: Public debate space for agent-drafted proposals

buildings.name: Draft Review Pavilion
buildings.use: Human review of drafts before final vote

buildings.name: Collaborator Outpost
buildings.use: Scouting hub for experts and collaborators

court.name: The Aqueduct Court
court.style: Dry-limestone Roman tribunal on the Pont du Gard's left-bank terrace, framed by the aqueduct's three tiers
court.why_here: Two millennia of enduring public infrastructure mirror the charter's mission: governance built to last and shared as a public good.

quests.title: Carve the Charter
steps: Read the mission stele in the Charter Tablet Room
Copy the measurable outcomes into a ledger
Carry the draft to the Proposal Forum
Defend it in the Debate Ring

quests.title: Evidence on the Current
steps: Collect three monitored summaries at the Monitoring Desk
Cross-check them against the Evidence Stacks
Deliver the synthesis to the Milestone Gallery

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Collect routed task scrolls from the Routing Wheel Room
Cross Pont Pitot to brief the scouts
Return with collaborator findings to the Synthesis Studio

quests.title: The Final Vote of the Gardon
steps: Review the agent-drafted proposal at the Draft Tables
Hear debate in the Debate Ring
Escalate the final vote to human stewards
Record the outcome in the Charter Hall ledger

quests.title: Bridge the Outcomes
steps: Audit the tally wall against the Outcome Mirror Room
Flag shortfalls to the Task Router
Watch a working group re-task on the Routing Wheel
